_note: AI-proposed mapping for the discovery report. Statuses are proposals: Ready means everything the component needs already exists in Drupal; Component only means frontend work with props and existing media, no new Drupal structure; Needs Drupal structure means a content-model or backend decision the developer must approve before building. Verified mappings from the hand-built homepage slices are marked verified.

mappings.note: Global: lives in the Alpina page variant, not on pages. FR/NL switcher is visual-only.
Global: Footer slot of the page shell. Footer menu links are <nolink> placeholders until those pages exist.
One component with an image/video variant (mediaType prop), not two components. Same pattern as the video test page.

uses: Product nodes: title, summary, teaser image, destination link

Card content (collection, name, image, benefits) comes from Product nodes. alpinaweiss instances add mobile/desktop headline spans.

uses: Product nodes: inspiration image + field_inspiration_weight ordering
mappings.note: 8 cards per instance on both pages; same structure.
